newsitem.title: EGYPT: PRESS DIGEST - Egypt economic press - May 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Egypt economic press - May 11.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian economic press this week. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
AL-BORSA
- Stock market sets up a complaints office.
- Director of Abu Qir Fertilisers and Chemical Industries says company's next general assembly meeting will discuss offering shares to foreigners.
- East Delta Flour Mills pre-tax profits for first nine months of financial 1996/7 up to 34.5 million pounds from 28.5 million in same period last year.

- Arab Drugs and Chemical Industries pre-tax and unnaudited net profit for first nine months up 7.3 percent to 8.7 million pounds from 8.11 million in the same year ago period. Unaudited revenue up 6.19 percent to 83.89 million pounds.
- Delta Insurance after tax net profit for year that ended in December 1996 up to 5.9 million pounds from 5.4 million in 1995. Total revenue up to 9.2 million from 8.5 million.

- Alexandria Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries pre-tax, unaudited net profit for first nine months up 15.1 percent to 25.55 million pounds from 22.2 million. Revenue up by 9.98 percent to 113.49 million pounds from 103.19 million.
- Eastern Company pre-tax net profit for first nine months that end in March up to 122.5 million pounds from 102.2 million in same period last year. Revenue up to 1.44 million from 1.28 million.

- Misr Free Shops (MFSC.CA delays extraordinary general assembly. After-tax net profit up to 13.43 million pounds in 1995.6 financial year compared to 9.16 million in previous year. Company expects to make 15 million pounds in net profit for 1996/97 financial year. Net sales for 1995/96 year were 103.91 million pounds. Company expects them to rise to 121 million pounds at the end of 1996/97.
- Egyptian Starch and Glucose ESGI.CA pre-tax profits for first nine months of 1996/97 down to 21.787 million pounds from 24.962 million in same year ago period.

- Memphis Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries MPCI.CA pre-tax, unaudited net profit for first nine months up 48.39 percent to 21.358 million from 14.393 million in the same period last year. Revenue in period that ended in March up about 11.8 percent to 100.93 million from 90.29 million.

- Helwan Portland Cement HELW.CA unaudited pre-tax net profit in first nine months up by 34.4 percent to 141.72 million pounds from 113.96 million in same year ago period. Revenue up 16.8 percent to 514.63 million from 440.65 million.
- Engineering Industries Company offered investors at least 330,000 shares or 10 percent of its holdings in partly privatised Egyptian Electro Cables ELEC.CA.
- Misr Oil and Soap MOSC.CA net profit for nine-month-period that ended in December up to 21.866 million from 21.377 million in same year ago period.
- Egyptian Tora Portland Cement TORA.CA pre-tax profit for first nine months up to 152.2 million pounds from 112.7 million in same year ago period. Revenue up to 452.1 million from 403.2 million.

- Ahli for Development and Investment wants to increase issued and paid up capital to 200 million pounds. Board of directors have decided to raise capital by issuing new shares, 35 percent of which will go to the public.
Increase in capital expected to follow registration of company's shares on stock exchange next month.
Company was established with paid up capital of 100 million pounds, 10 percent of which came from National Bank of Egypt and 10 percent from Misr Insurance Company.
Company's net profit in first three months of 1996/7 financial year was up to 55.6 million from 18.45 million last year.

Ahli for Development and Investment made net profits of 18.46 million pounds in its first year, which comprised nine month period that ended in December 1996. Company gave out dividend of 13 pounds per share for this period.
